Care Secure is underwritten and issued by Income Insurance Limited and only distributed by Prudential; its second PDF (contract on income.com.sg) returned 404 and is omitted.
DIRECT - PRUProtect Term and DIRECT - PRUProtect Term 5 have separate pages and are listed once; Term 5 page: https://www.prudential.com.sg/en/products/life/term-life/direct-pruprotect-term-5/
PRUExtra has no page of its own; it is described on the PRUShield page (same URL). PRUExtra Plus Lite / Premier Lite / Plus Lite CoPay are marked withdrawn there and left out.

Pages in the sitemap but not in any hub menu were left out: PRULink ActiveInvest Portfolio (fund), PRUWealth Plus xsell variants, PRUVantage Assure/Wealth xsell (redirect to homepage), PRULink FlexGrowth xsell, PRURetirement Growth (redirects to homepage), claims-based-pricing pages (rider withdrawn notice).

Categorisation: lifetime-income participating plans (PRUWealth Income, PRUWealth Income II, PRULifetime Income Plus, PRUIndex Lifetime Income) are described by Prudential as whole life, so they are whole_life; only PRUActive Retirement II is annuity.
Channel: pages route enquiries through Prudential Financial Representatives; DIRECT plans are labelled direct purchase. Purchase channel for Care Secure not stated.
PRUActive Family Care page shows an early-bird promotion ending 31 October; promotions are not recorded as facts.
